the following models of higher dimensional neutrinos are excluded by data: 1) flavor blind brane bulk couplings plus three flavor diagonal neutrinos; 2) flavor blind branes plus two flavor diagonal neutrinos plus a fourth sterile neutrino; 3) flavor blind braned plus three flavor diagonal light neutrinos plus a heavy Majorana neutrino; 4) flavor blind brained plus two flavor diagonal light neutrino plus a fourth sterile light neutrino plus two heavy Majorana neutrinos

The main takeaway from our work is that

the data on neutrino mixing and masses are very restrictive, and that models of neutrinos with extra dimensions must be designed in such a way that they do not lead to flavor blind mixing, if they are to survive the confrontation with data.
